# executes procedure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:executesProcedure`](gmeow-executesProcedure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/executesProcedure>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an [`Execution`](../classes/gmeow-Execution.md) to the [`Procedure`](../classes/gmeow-Procedure.md) it enacts. Non-functional: an execution may enact multiple procedures (a combined run), and competing enactment claims coexist.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Execution`](../classes/gmeow-Execution.md) -> [`gmeow:Procedure`](../classes/gmeow-Procedure.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:executesProcedure`](gmeow-executesProcedure.md) from [`gmeow:Execution`](../classes/gmeow-Execution.md) to [`gmeow:Procedure`](../classes/gmeow-Procedure.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
